data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ioseph, meaning 'God will add'. Josy is a diminutive of Joseph and is popular as a girl's name in various cultures. In Christianity, Joseph is the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name Josy carries the meaning “God is Help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Josy usually hope their child will grow to embody god is help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Josy belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is Help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Josy total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: Josy is a name deeply rooted in various Christian communities, particularly those of European origin. While it's a diminutive of Joseph, it's popularly used as a standalone name for girls. It holds cultural significance as a reminder of the important role Joseph played in the Christian faith as the spouse of Mary, and the foster father of Jesus.
data.spiritual_significance: As a diminutive of Joseph, the name Josy holds deep spiritual meaning for Christians. It's a reminder that, as the name implies, God will add to our lives in countless ways. In the Christian faith, this can be understood through the example of Saint Joseph who, though a humble carpenter, was chosen to be the guardian and protector of Jesus and Mary. Through the name Josy, we are called to trust in God's divine plan for our lives and to remain open to the many blessings and graces he bestows upon us.
